The '''Palace District''' was one of the four districts of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Jorra]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]. The wealthy families of Jorra lived in the Palace District, though many homes fell into disrepair during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]] because of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation's]] loss of power after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], which greatly affected the finances of many residents.<ref name="CotG" />
